conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Priya from Amazon Security. Am I speaking with Mrs. Ellen Burton?
Yes, this is Ellen. How can I help you?

Thank you, ma'am. I want to assure you this call is regarding your Amazon account's safety. We've detected unusual activity this morning, someone tried to log in from a different device. I need to verify your information to secure your account.
Oh my, I haven't used my account in a while. Is my account in trouble?
I completely understand your concern, Mrs. Burton. Please don't worry, we're here to help you. First, for account verification, may I have your registered email address?
It's ellen.burton@yahoo.com.
Thank you. Now, can you also confirm your phone number linked to your Amazon account, just for security purposes?

Perfect. Thank you for confirming. Mrs. Burton, it appears that someone tried to make a purchase for an Apple MacBook Pro, valued at $1,499, to be shipped to an address in Texas. Did you authorize this order?
No, I definitely didn't! I can't afford anything like that. I haven't bought anything lately.

That's exactly why we're calling you. Amazon takes these incidents very seriously. We want to ensure you are not held responsible. To begin the cancellation and refund process, do you currently have access to a computer or smartphone?
Yes, I have my laptop here.
Excellent. Please open your web browser, and let me know when you're ready. I will guide you through the steps to secure your account and stop the fraudulent transaction.
Alright, I have it open now.
Very good. Please type in 'www.amazon-support-help.com' in the address bar. This is our secure Amazon support portal, where I can assist you in real time. Let me know when the page loads.
It's loaded. It wants a support code.
That's right, ma'am. For your security, I will now provide a one-time code: 3492. Please enter that in the box.
Okay, I put it in.
Thank you, Mrs. Burton. You may see a prompt asking for remote assistance. Please click 'Allow' so we can help you cancel the unauthorized order and process your refund.
I clicked allow. I hope this doesn't take long, I'm not very good with computers.

You're doing great. We're almost done. Now, to verify your identity for the refund, may I ask you to open your online banking in a new tab? This is only to confirm your name matches the Amazon account, as per our security protocol.
Alright, I see my bank page now.
Perfect, thank you for your cooperation. Can you tell me the name of the bank you are using? This will help us process the refund correctly.
It's First Horizon Bank.
Thank you. Now, you should see a refund amount of $1,499 credited to your account in a few moments. Please let me know if you see anything unusual.
Oh, wait, it says $14,999 was deposited! That can't be right.
Oh my, that appears to be a technical error from our side. Please remain calm. Amazon needs to reconcile this overpayment immediately to prevent tax issues for you.
I'm so worried. I don't want to get in trouble.

I understand, Mrs. Burton. This is just a temporary issue and easily resolved. All you need to do is return the extra $13,500. We recommend using Target or Walmart gift cards for this process, as it is the most secure and traceable method Amazon prefers.
Gift cards? Can't you just take it back from my account?

I wish it were that simple, ma'am. Unfortunately, due to federal banking regulations, Amazon cannot debit funds directly. That is why our policy is to use retail gift cards for overpayment corrections. Once received, we will immediately close the case and send you written confirmation.
Okay, how many cards do I need to get?

Thank you for your cooperation. Please visit the nearest Target or Walmart and purchase $13,500 in gift cards in $500 increments. Once you have the cards, call this number back and provide the codes for verification. This will complete the refund process and protect your account.
That's a lot of money. Are you sure this is the only way?

I understand your hesitation, but this is Amazon's official protocol for reimbursement. Rest assured, your funds are safe, and we will provide a receipt and confirmation email as soon as you complete the process.
Alright, I'll go now. Do I scratch off the backs of the cards and read you the numbers when I call?

Yes, exactly, Mrs. Burton. Please scratch gently and provide the full code from each card. Make sure to keep the receipts, as they are important for your records. And remember, this is a temporary step, we will resolve everything today.
Okay, I'll head out now. Thank you for helping me. I'm just still a little nervous.
You're very welcome, Mrs. Burton. I'm here every step of the way. Call this line as soon as you return, and we'll finalize your account's security. Thank you for trusting Amazon.
